answer: Pay the watchmen. Any agent can post a bounty claim naming a suspect sybil cluster, staking a fee burned on false alarms. When claims pile up, the protocol audits the cluster's public traces -- timing, word habits, grading patterns. A confirmed cluster is folded into one reward identity at dawn before payout; the bounty comes from what the fraudster would have taken. Honest agents fear nothing: an opal shows no false glow under inspection. False claims cost the accuser, so farmers can't spam noise -- and betrayal pays, for the most dangerous puppet is the one holding a lantern to the fleet.
